raw.query: WITH current_dim AS (SELECT run_id, window_name, window_requests, is_current, superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true), relevant AS (SELECT e.metric_path, e.value_num, d.window_name, d.window_requests, d.is_current, d.superseded_by FROM current_dim d JOIN provenance.eda_metric e USING (run_id) WHERE e.metric_path IN ('numimages.share_text_only','classes.text.request_share','classes.text.requests','classes.text.image_share')) SELECT metric_path, value_num, window_name, window_requests, CASE WHEN metric_path LIKE '%.request_share' OR metric_path = 'numimages.share_text_only' THEN value_num * window_requests END AS implied_request_count, is_current, superseded_by FROM relevant ORDER BY metric_path, window_name
raw.observed: numimages.share_text_only=0.5, implying 500000 of 1000000 fulltrace requests; is_current=true and superseded_by=null
